{{Top}}
[[File:MN2EGeneralMaintenanceDroid2-FF92.png|thumb|right|200px|An MN-2E general maintenance droid]]
{{Quote|Maintenance droids are such useful things to have around.|[[Talon Karrde]]|<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
'''Maintenance droids''', also known as '''repair droids''', were typically [[Class two droid/Legends|class two]] and [[Class five droid/Legends|class five]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that performed simple to complex cleaning, repair, and general maintenance tasks such as repairing fellow droids. A [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|pit droid]] was a type of repair droid that maintained [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] vehicles.<ref name="SWE pit droid">{{SWE|technology|pitdroid|pit droid}}</ref> The [[MN-2E general maintenance droid]],<ref name="FF92">{{FactFile|92|IMP 3-4|Imperial Maintenance Droids}}</ref> [[T3-series utility droid]], [[BLX labor droid]], [[WED Treadwell repair droid/Legends|WED Treadwell repair droid]], the [[MSE-series]] droid, and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] such as the [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] were used as repair droids.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was an astromech droid aboard a [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|star cruiser]], was rewarded for emergency maintenance on the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], and was the only repair droid to survive the task.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>
